title: Radio: Primary color (daisyUI)
notes:
Radio buttons allow the user to select one option from a set.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/radio/+page.md
code:
<input type="radio" name="radio-4" class="radio radio-primary" checked="checked" />
<input type="radio" name="radio-4" class="radio radio-primary" />
